content.description:
Zamunda is a Play-to-Earn metaverse game on Cardano blockchain. A simulation real-estate adventure game that was inspired by two times Oscar award nominated film titled 'Coming to America.' Ever since then, people have been wondering if Zamunda really exists.

Use Cases: Hold to Earn Play-to-Earn (DeFi metaverse platform) NFT Staking Governance Token Staking Purchase In-Game NFT Items.
